name: Eliada
overview: Eliada is a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Rezon, mentioned in 1 Kings 11:23. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional details about his life in Scripture. His mention is brief, highlighting his role in the genealogy of a notable individual.
namesAndTitles: The name Eliada means 'G-d knows,' reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew name. This proper name, recorded in 1 Kings 11:23, does not appear to have been given directly by God but carries a meaning that emphasizes divine knowledge.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Eliada as the father of Rezon, as noted in 1 Kings 11:23. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Eliada's significance lies in his identification as the father of Rezon, a figure mentioned in the context of the biblical narrative in 1 Kings. While Eliada himself is not the focus of major events, his mention establishes a lineage important for understanding the background of Rezon, contributing to the broader historical and theological setting of the era.
